added.description:
Company Description

Butterfly Network, Inc. (NYSE: BFLY) is driving a digital revolution in ultrasound imaging and sensing with its proprietary Ultrasound-on-Chip™ semiconductor technology and software solutions. Butterfly first proved its technology in the point-of-care ultrasound market – commercializing the world’s first single-probe, whole-body portable ultrasound device, which is now on its best-selling, third-generation: Butterfly iQ3™. The Company combines its advanced hardware with cloud software and AI, an enterprise workflow solution (Compass AI™) and other offerings to drive adoption of affordable, accessible ultrasound. Butterfly also enables third-party development of imaging AI apps through Butterfly Garden™, its software development kit and AI partnership initiative.

In addition to its medical imaging products, Butterfly Embedded™ is the Company’s Ultrasound-on-Chip™ licensing and co-development program designed to enable a new wave of ultrasound-enabled technologies across non-competitive healthcare markets and beyond. Through Butterfly Embedded™, partners can build and scale novel ultrasound applications powered by Butterfly’s proprietary semiconductor chip and software platform. Butterfly’s innovations have been recognized by Prix Galien USA, Fierce 50, TIME’s Best Inventions and Fast Company’s World Changing Ideas, among other achievements.

We’re a team of bold thinkers, problem-solvers, and innovators ready to shape the future of medical imaging. Let’s build something extraordinary together!

Job Description

We are seeking a seasoned engineering leader to lead our Full Stack Engineering team, responsible for building and scaling our critical Enterprise Clinical workflows platform. The Butterfly Cloud provides a secure and robust connection to user's health information — powering tools and services that help doctors and clinicians make informed, intelligent diagnostic decisions with the help of their peers.

As Director, you will lead a distributed team of engineers across both onshore and offshore locations, setting the technical direction for our enterprise platform — including user and organization administration, feature and entitlement management, global search, audit logging, and scalable platform features. You'll partner closely with Product, Design, and other engineering leaders to shape roadmap priorities and drive execution across the full stack.

As part of our team, your core responsibilities will be to:

Lead, grow, and inspire a high-performing full stack engineering team spanning onshore and offshore engineers — fostering a culture of excellence, ownership, and continuous improvement.
Define and drive the technical strategy and architecture for the Enterprise Clinical workflows platform, balancing innovation with reliability, security, and scalability.
Own engineering roadmap execution — partnering with Product and Design to translate business goals into clear, well-scoped plans, and holding the team accountable to delivery.
Recruit, retain, and develop top engineering talent; build a healthy team culture where people grow and do their best work.
Establish and evolve engineering processes — code review standards, on-call practices, incident response, and cross-team ways of working — to maximize team effectiveness across time zones.
Serve as a senior technical voice across the organization, contributing to architectural decisions, evaluating new technologies, and raising the bar on engineering quality.
Build strong cross-functional relationships with Product, Design, Data, Security, and Compliance stakeholders to ensure alignment and unblock the team.
Drive a culture of observability, operational excellence, and HIPAA/PHI compliance across the platform.

Qualifications

Baseline skills/experiences/attributes:

6+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 3–5 years in engineering management or a senior technical leadership role.
Proven track record of leading distributed engineering teams, including managing offshore or nearshore teams across multiple time zones.
Deep understanding of distributed systems, cloud architecture, and full stack web development at scale. Experience hiring, developing, and retaining senior engineering talent; track record of building strong, cohesive teams.
Strong product sensibility — ability to translate ambiguous business problems into clear engineering plans and drive execution with minimal direction.
Excellent communication and influencing skills; comfortable presenting to senior leadership and partnering across functions.
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.

Ideally, you also have these skills/experiences/attributes (but it’s ok if you don’t!):

GraphQL and related frameworks (e.g., Relay, Apollo, URQL)
Experience with LLMs and MLOps Containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker, ECS, EKS Web apps with live updates — pub/sub solutions (such as Redis), WebSockets
Designing and building observability solutions utilizing modern monitoring, logging, and metrics tools Frontend experience with React and TypeScript Opensearch or other Lucene-based search engines
HIPAA, PHI, and PII compliance
Experience leading engineering teams in health tech, medical devices, or other regulated industries

Values

Innovation is what we do. Our values are how we make it happen. Butterflies are and believe in…

Patient-Centric Innovators: Our mission is THE mission.
Empowered to Impact: Every voice matters.
One Team, One Goal: Unity fuels progress.
Growth Champions: We embrace challenges.
Action-Oriented Achievers: We follow through, every time.

Location

Butterfly offers a hybrid work model for most positions, with team members spending two or more days a week in the office. While flexibility is key, we value in-person connections that spark creativity and teamwork. Our offices are designed for collaboration, with comfortable workspaces, stocked kitchens, and opportunities to connect with peers.

Our preference for this role is that this is a hybrid position and will be based out of our office in New York City, NY.

Benefits And Perks

Comprehensive health insurance, encompassing dental and vision coverage, is provided to all our employees. As a health-tech company, we prioritize the well-being of our teams. We also contribute to Health Savings Account (HSA) accounts for all enrolled employees on an annual basis.
Comprehensive Employee Assistance Program - we provide access to tools and resources to support your emotional health and day-to-day needs.
401k plan and match - we facilitate your retirement goals.
Eligible employees will have the opportunity to participate in Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
Unlimited Paid Time Off + 10 Holiday Days a Year - recharge and come back ready to make an impact
Parental Leave - we aim to provide our employees with time to bond with their growing family, along with additional support for primary caregivers to help transition back to work
Competitive salaried compensation - we value our employees and show it
Equity - we want every employee to be a stakeholder
The opportunity to build a revolutionary healthcare product and save millions of lives!

Compensation

Our estimated salary for this role is around $250,000 + bonus + equity + benefits. Actual pay is determined by multiple factors such as skills, qualifications, experience and market demand.

Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. Butterfly Network will not provide immigration sponsorship of any kind for this position, including but not limited to H-1B, TN, O-1, L-1, or green card sponsorship (this includes applicants that are in the process of obtaining a greencard), now or in the future.

Butterfly Network does not accept agency resumes.

Butterfly Network is an E-Verify Company.

Butterfly Network is an equal opportunity employer. Regardless of race, traits associated with race, color, ancestry, religion, gender, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or Veteran status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Butterfly requires security adherence responsibilities from all employees. These include: adhering to all company security policies and procedures, utilize provided company assets securely, and complete all required security awareness training programs. Safeguarding company data and systems from unauthorized access, modification, or destruction, contributing to the overall security posture of the organization. Immediately reporting any suspected or actual security incidents, including phishing attempts, malware infections, or unauthorized access, following the established incident response procedure

Overview

This is a remote role that may only be hired in the following location(s): North Carolina or Arizona

We are seeking an experienced Director to lead the AI platform engineering and enablement functions within our expanding Cloud Data and AI Platform organization. This role is instrumental in building, operationalizing, and governing the next-generation AI and machine learning ecosystem that powers advanced analytics and responsible AI adoption across the bank. You will own the end-to-end AI lifecycle—from data and model development to MLOps, deployment, governance, and responsible AI compliance in a regulated financial environment.

As a seasoned technology leader, you will bring your expertise in enterprise AI architecture, model operations, and platform engineering to partner with key business, technology, and governance stakeholders—ensuring AI initiatives are responsibly implemented, well-controlled, and deliver measurable value.

Responsibilities & Qualifications

AWS AI/ML Platform Ownership

Architect and lead AI/ML workloads on AWS including:
Amazon SageMaker (training, deployment, model registry)
AWS Bedrock (foundation models and GenAI use cases)
AWS Lambda, ECS, EKS for model serving
S3, Glue, Snowflake for data pipelines

Define enterprise standards for MLOps, feature stores, and model lifecycle management
Build and maintain integrations with enterprise platforms for data ingestion, metadata management, tokenization, and control evidence generation.
Continuously enhance the platform’s automation, resilience, and observability, ensuring robust end-to-end telemetry for both model and data pipelines.
Collaborate with Enterprise Risk, Legal, Compliance, and Model Risk partners to embed Responsible AI principles and audit-ready control evidence directly into platform design.

Machine Learning & GenAI Execution

Oversee development of ML models across all business units including Fraud detection systems, Credit scoring and risk modeling, Customer segmentation and personalization, Liquidity related modeling etc.
Lead GenAI initiatives using LLMs for Document intelligence, AI copilots etc.

Data & Engineering Collaboration

Partner with data engineering teams to ensure high-quality, governed datasets
Define feature engineering and data product standards in Snowflake / data lake environments
Integrate real-time streaming data for low-latency decision systems

Model Governance & Risk Compliance

Define and enforce standards, patterns, and guardrails for model deployment, explainability, lineage, and monitoring in alignment with enterprise risk, compliance, and security frameworks.
Partner closely with leaders across Responsible AI Governance, AI Portfolio Management, AI Fluency & Engagement, and Applied Data Science & GenAI, in collaboration with enterprise risk partners, to implement a responsible AI framework that embeds audit-ready control evidence and governance mechanisms directly into the platform’s core design to ensure the platform supports scalable, ethical, compliant, and high-impact AI delivery.
Implement model explainability (SHAP, LIME, interpretability frameworks)
Establish responsible AI policies (bias detection, fairness, auditability)

Team Building & Leadership

Develop and mentor engineering talent, championing Agile practices, continuous learning, and adoption of emerging AI and data engineering technologies.
Mentor senior technical leaders and establish engineering best practices
Oversee technical due diligence, onboarding, and management of strategic AI and GenAI vendors and tools, ensuring compatibility with enterprise architecture and control.

Bachelor's Degree and 8 years of experience in Information Technology including application development, support roles, and management.

OR

High School Diploma or GED and 12 years of experience in Information Technology including application development, support roles, and management.

Qualifications

Deep hands-on experience building production ML systems on AWS
2+ years in AI/ML, data science, or data engineering leadership roles
Strong knowledge of:
Machine learning (XGBoost, deep learning, NLP, time series)
MLOps practices (CI/CD, model monitoring, drift detection)
Distributed systems and cloud architecture

Strong programming background in Python + SQL (Scala/Java a plus)
Experience working in regulated environments with model governance

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Generative AI / LLM platforms (Bedrock, OpenAI, Claude APIs)
Experience in financial services, banking, fintech, or insurance
Familiarity with data platforms like Snowflake, Databricks

The Role

As the Director, Data Platform
, you blend deep expertise in mainframe development, enterprise data platforms, application modernization, and large-scale technology delivery with a passion for coaching, mentoring, and developing engineering talent. You are committed to modernizing critical recordkeeping platforms while maintaining the resiliency, stability, and performance required to support a global enterprise. In an agile structure, you will collaborate with Product Area Leaders, Architects, Engineering Leaders, and Data Platform teams to define strategic modernization roadmaps, establish engineering standards, and drive execution across mainframe, distributed, and cloud-based solutions. You are dedicated to helping teams evolve legacy platforms, adopt modern engineering practices, and deliver business outcomes through innovation, operational excellence, and technical leadership.

In Addition, You

Bring passion to your work to inspire and motivate teams through large-scale transformation initiatives
Embody the firm's Leadership Principles and engineering culture
Foster a culture of engineering excellence, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement
Champion modernization efforts across mainframe, distributed, and cloud platforms
Promote resiliency, operational excellence, and customer-focused delivery
Develop and mentor engineering talent while supporting high-performing, globally distributed teams
Serve as a trusted advisor to business and technology leaders on modernization strategy and platform evolution
Enjoy what you do!

The Expertise And Skills You Bring

Bachelor's degree required in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field
12 plus years of software engineering experience, including significant experience supporting and developing large-scale mainframe applications
Deep expertise with COBOL, JCL, CICS, DB2, VSAM, and enterprise mainframe development practices
Strong experience designing, developing, and supporting mission-critical recordkeeping, transaction processing, and data management platforms
Hands-on experience with SQL in DB2 and Oracle environments
Experience driving application modernization initiatives, including API enablement, legacy transformation, cloud integration, and platform simplification
Experience with Java, RESTful services, and distributed application architectures preferred
Experience with ETL technologies, Informatica, data integration, and large-volume data processing
Experience with cloud platforms, preferably Azure, and cloud-native engineering practices is a bonus
Experience with event streaming technologies such as Kafka and low-latency data platforms such as Redis is a plus
Strong understanding of Agile delivery methodologies, DevSecOps practices, and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles
Proven ability to influence engineering and technology strategy across multiple organizations and stakeholder groups
Strong stakeholder management, communication, and organizational leadership capabilities
Critical thinking skills and experience balancing modernization objectives with operational stability and risk management
Financial Services experience preferred

The Value You Deliver

Provide technical and organizational leadership for globally distributed engineering teams responsible for critical business applications
Partner with Product, Architecture, Security, and Engineering leaders to deliver business solutions that align with strategic objectives and technology roadmaps
Establish engineering standards, architecture principles, and governance practices that promote scalability, resiliency, maintainability, and security
Lead modernization initiatives involving cloud integration, API enablement, application transformation, and data platform evolution
Drive adoption of modern engineering practices including Agile, DevSecOps, automation, observability, and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)
Remove organizational and technical impediments that impact team effectiveness, delivery execution, and platform performance
Champion operational excellence through proactive risk management, system resiliency, performance optimization, and continuous improvement initiatives
Ensure platforms meet reliability, security, compliance, performance, scalability, and availability objectives
Communicate strategy, priorities, progress, risks, and outcomes effectively to senior leadership and executive stakeholders
Guide investment decisions and modernization priorities by balancing business value, technical debt reduction, platform stability, and long-term strategic outcomes
Build and develop a high-performing engineering organization through mentorship, coaching, talent development, and succession planning
Foster innovation and adoption of emerging technologies and modernization patterns that support the organization's long-term data platform and technology vision

Position Summary:
Concentric is seeking a highly technical, investment-fluent Director of Investment Technology
to oversee the modernization, development, and operational scaling of Concentric’s investment technology platform. This leader will be responsible for the engineering team, database management, workflow automation, and the evolution of Concentric’s proprietary codebase supporting model management, portfolio optimization, trading, reconciliation, reporting, and investment operations. This role will require a hands-on technology leader with experience in quantitative investment management, systematic portfolio implementation, data engineering, and mission-critical investment systems. The ideal candidate will have worked in or closely supported a quantitative investment management firm, systematic asset manager, hedge fund, direct indexing platform, or similarly sophisticated investment technology environment where code, data, models, trading, and operations are tightly integrated.

The mandate is to build a durable, institutional-grade technology foundation that allows Concentric to scale with AUM growth, account growth, strategy complexity, and broader Pathstone adoption while reducing manual processes, human inputs, spreadsheet dependency, and key-person risk. The role will prioritize engineering discipline, database architecture, workflow automation, code quality, system reliability, throughput, controls, and operational leverage across the full investment lifecycle—from model ingestion and portfolio construction through order generation, trade execution, reconciliation, exception management, and post-trade analytics. Key Responsibilities

Infrastructure, Automation & Scale

Our client is an early-stage infrastructure company building one of the most critical layers of the AI ecosystem: power. As demand for AI compute continues to grow, traditional utility timelines are becoming a major bottleneck for new data center development. This company is solving that challenge by developing modular, behind-the-meter power solutions that can be deployed in a fraction of the time required for conventional infrastructure.

Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in the technology sector, the organization is combining expertise across power, real estate, and computing infrastructure to enable the next generation of AI data centers. Backed by a well-capitalized leadership team and operating at the intersection of energy and artificial intelligence, they're tackling one of the industry's most pressing challenges: bringing power online fast enough to support the AI revolution.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Head of Modular Engineering
to lead the development, manufacturing, and scale-up of modular power generation systems used to support high-density AI infrastructure.
Reporting directly to the founders, this individual will own the complete engineering lifecycle of the company's modular power product line, from architecture and design through manufacturing, testing, and deployment. This is a highly visible leadership role with significant influence over product strategy, technical direction, and operational scale.

The successful candidate will serve as the technical authority for the platform while building and leading the engineering and manufacturing teams responsible for bringing these systems to market.

Defining the technical architecture of modular power generation systems, including generation, controls, switchgear, energy storage, cooling, and auxiliary systems
Leading multidisciplinary engineering efforts across electrical, mechanical, controls, and structural disciplines
Establishing technical standards, performance requirements, and quality benchmarks
Managing relationships with OEMs, suppliers, and integration partners
Driving manufacturing readiness, assembly processes, factory testing, and quality programs
Scaling production capacity to support rapid deployment across multiple projects

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

About the Role:

We are seeking a highly strategic and technically fluent AI for Operations Director to lead our AI for Operations portfolio within the AI Acceleration organization.

This leader will be responsible for defining and executing the AI strategy supporting Global Operations & Planning (GO&P), Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Planning, Strategy, Incentive Compensation, Workforce Planning, and Business Operations teams. The role combines people leadership, AI solution delivery, stakeholder management, and technical oversight to accelerate the adoption of AI across operational workflows.

You will lead a team of AI Engineers while partnering closely with Data Engineers, Program Managers, Digital Technology, Business Operations leaders, and executive stakeholders to identify opportunities, prioritize investments, and build scalable AI-powered solutions that improve how we operate globally.

The ideal candidate understands both business operations and modern AI technologies. They can translate complex operational challenges into scalable AI solutions while building high-performing engineering teams capable of delivering measurable business outcomes.

Your work will directly impact productivity, decision quality, planning accuracy, operational efficiency, and employee experience across some of ServiceNow's most critical business functions. By aligning AI capabilities with business priorities, you will help accelerate ServiceNow’s journey toward becoming a $30B+ business.

Key Responsibilities

Lead and develop a team of AI Engineers responsible for designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining AI-powered solutions for Operations teams.
Own the AI for Operations portfolio, including roadmap planning, prioritization, resource allocation, stakeholder alignment, and business value realization.
Partner with GO&P, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Planning, Strategy, Workforce Planning, and Business Operations leaders to identify high-impact AI opportunities.
Drive the design and deployment of agentic AI solutions, copilots, workflow automation, knowledge systems, predictive analytics, and operational intelligence capabilities.
Establish technical standards, engineering best practices, governance frameworks, and responsible AI guidelines across the Operations AI portfolio.
Collaborate closely with Data Engineers to ensure scalable, secure, and compliant data foundations for AI solutions.
Manage project intake, prioritization, portfolio health, and capacity planning across AI Engineering resources.
Define and track success metrics tied to business outcomes. Ie: Productivity gains, cycle-time reduction, forecast accuracy, process automation, and user adoption.
Partner with Adoption Leads and Enablement teams to ensure successful rollout and sustained value realization of AI solutions.
Evaluate emerging technologies, vendors, and platforms to continuously improve our AI ecosystem and delivery capabilities.
Communicate progress, risks, investment recommendations, and business impact to senior leadership and executive stakeholders.

Your day might begin with a portfolio review of active AI initiatives, assessing delivery status, resource allocation, and business impact across multiple Operations functions.
Mid-morning, you facilitate a prioritization session with Revenue Operations and Planning leaders to evaluate new AI opportunities and align on the highest-value investments for the upcoming quarter. Later, you review solution architecture proposals from AI Engineers, providing guidance on scalability, governance, and integration with enterprise platforms.
In the afternoon, you meet with executive stakeholders to present portfolio performance, adoption metrics, business outcomes, and strategic recommendations for future investments.
You close the day coaching members of your AI Engineering team, removing roadblocks, and ensuring delivery teams remain focused on the initiatives that create the greatest impact for the business.

Proven leader who can build, develop, and inspire high-performing technical teams.
Deep understanding of operational business processes and how AI can transform them.
Experienced in translating executive priorities into actionable technical roadmaps.
Comfortable operating at both strategic and technical levels.
Strong systems thinker capable of identifying scalable opportunities across complex organizations.
Exceptional collaborator who can influence across functions, levels, and geographies.
Curious, autonomous, data-driven, and outcome-oriented.

Experience with Copilot Studio, Snowflake AI, Databricks, APIs, integrations, and modern cloud architectures.

Leadership & Communication

Ability to influence without authority across complex organizations.
Skilled at navigating ambiguity and driving alignment among senior stakeholders.

Successfully deployed and measured return on AI4Ops 2026 roadmap.

Improved Sales Operations productivity through AI-enabled workflows and intelligent automation.

About The Team

The Tax Technology team owns the technology behind what happens on our platform. We build and run the systems that calculate indirect tax on every transaction — and we go well beyond that. We are a global team spanning three brands: DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo.

That reach also makes us one of the most dependency-heavy systems in the company. More than eight separate billing domains feed into our tax services, each with its own architecture, roadmap, and engineering team — and all of them have to work.

Getting this right is not optional. Tax has to be correct on every order, the first time. Getting it wrong means incorrect charges to real customers, restatement risk, and audit exposure. We are looking for someone who can hold the whole picture and make it land.

About The Role

The Senior Manager, Tax Technology Implementations reports to the Director of Tax Technology and owns the technical implementation plan between the various domains and our indirect tax calculation service. This position will be based on the East Coast to accommodate working in Eastern Time hours.

You have a deep understanding of the indirect Tax subject matter and also the technical partner to the engineering team. You will translate indirect tax requirements into things engineers can build, and you will own the single consolidated plan that tells Tax and Engineering leadership where the program actually stands.

You will influence partner teams with your understanding of the problem and source of truth of a trusted plan. You make it easy for partner teams to do the right thing.

This role owns the tax outcome of implementations— the requirements, the design judgment, and the technical calls that determine whether it works.

Requirements and design.
Author tax requirements and acceptance criteria that engineers build against and that hold up under audit. Review design docs and push back where a design won't scale to the tax rules coming.

Scope and sequencing.
Define what's in and out for each integration, own the critical path, and drive what ships when. When a team slips, know within a day what it means downstream — and bring options.

Roadmap influence.
Get tax work prioritized onto eight other teams' roadmaps and defend it when it's bumped — making this a collaboration between the engineering, product teams and tax.

Launch and operational readiness.
Define testing, monitoring, and rollout, set go/no-go and rollback criteria, and make sure each integration lands with runbooks, alerting, and a clear steady-state owner.

Risk.
Own the risk register and escalate with a recommendation attached. Be the person who saw it coming.

Running the program.
Maintain the integrated plan as the source of truth and keep the decision cadence across Tax, Product, Engineering, and Data — reporting status to senior leadership in a format they trust.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

Have visibility across the entire business, solving genuinely complex problems across many domains with both engineering and non-engineering partners.
Own an end-to-end program rather than a slice of one, with real consequences and real scope.
Work closely with engineers to shape design decisions, not just receive them.
Build the connective tissue for a program that spans three brands and multiple jurisdictions.
Be supported by Anthropics Claude suite of tooling and an extensive tax data mart to speed up analysis, planning, and daily operations.
Grow a team and a function that is still being defined.

We're excited about you because…

8+ years in a corporate tax department, public accounting, or technology consulting
Global or multi-country indirect tax implementation experience, and familiarity with non-US indirect tax regimes.
Hands-on experience implementing Marketplace Facilitator laws across jurisdictions.
Program or project management experience across multiple dependent engineering teams, including building plans, milestones, and dependency maps, and driving them to completion.
Direct engagement with engineering teams on product development, with working knowledge of software development processes. You can read a technical design document and tell whether it will hold.
Experience defining testing and monitoring strategies for systems where correctness matters.
Strong analytical skills, high organization, and real attention to detail, with the ability to hold both the big picture and the specifics.
Comfort operating without formal authority in a highly collaborative, multi-stakeholder environment. You are not afraid to challenge the status quo, and you do it in a way that keeps partners on your side.
